text:
nik: Heads-up: during today's eu-west promote payments-api v2.1.0->v2.2.0 we saw a config-driven 503 on readiness probes. Quick look suggests values merge dropped a required secret ref. deploy-bot flagged healthgate fail.
deploy-bot: Automated: promotion failed health checks. Suggested actions: rollback to v2.1.0 or apply a temporary values override. Reason: readiness failures likely from missing values.
marta: If it's just values drift we can hotpatch values without reverting chart. That preserves the chart version metrics for the test.
sre-oncall: Hotpatch acceptable if we include approver annotation and add a clear rollback timeline. We should snapshot the replicaset before changing.
tim: Commands: `kubectl get rs -lapp=payments-api -n prod -o yaml > rs-snap-1777014000.yaml` then create patch `patch-values.yaml` with the missing secretRef and run `deployctl rollout patch payments-api --values-file=patch-values.yaml`. Also annotate for audit: `kubectl annotate helmrelease payments-api release.redwood/temp-override=nik release.redwood/approver=sre-oncall --overwrite`.
nik: I'll run snapshot and apply patch. Adding release-note line after. Plan: monitor 10m; if still failing rollback to v2.1.0.
deploy-bot: Note: presence of `release.redwood/temp-override` suppresses automated rollback for 30m TTL. Manual rollback still available.
marta: Also add a short release-notes entry: "temporary values override applied to restore secretRef for readiness probes during v2.2.0 canary; will revert after stable or rollback if fails".
sre-oncall: Approving override. I'll watch error budgets and readiness metrics. If metrics worsen in next 8m we rollback.
tim: Patch applied and rollout triggered. `kubectl apply -f patch-values.yaml && deployctl rollout patch payments-api --values-file=patch-values.yaml`
ik: Patch looks good; readiness passing on canary at +4m. Monitoring continues.
deploy-bot: Audit: manual values override applied by nik at 1777014000. Auto-rollback suppression until 1777015800 (30m TTL).
sre-oncall: Metrics stable at +9m. If green at +12m unpin/snap back. Nik please update changelog and product notif.
ik: Updated changelog and pinged #product-notifications. Will remove temp-override annotation once promote reaches steady state.
marta: Follow-up ticket created INFRA-2701 to add values-merge validation in CI to catch dropped keys on chart bumps.
ik: Closing unless we hit regressions; thanks all.
